text: You just choked on your steak, and you're home alone. Here's what to do.
If you can't cough, talk, or breathe, your airway is blocked.
Without air, your brain can start getting hurt in about four minutes.
Call 911 anyway and leave the line open. They can often see where you are. Then make a fist.
Put it just above your belly button, grab it, lean over a chair, and push in and up, hard.
Keep going until the food pops out.
Don't stick your fingers down your throat. It can push the food deeper.
